meaning:
συν-απο-στέλλω
[in LXX: Exo.33:2, 12 (שָׁלַח), I Est.5:2 * ;]
to send along with: with accusative, 2Co.12:18 (cf. MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?
